Save a spax accessibility analysis

Source: R/00-spax_save_and_read.R
save_spax.Rd

Saves the result of a floating catchment analysis (an object of class spax) with its rasters. A result of spax() (a spax_allocation) is saved with saveRDS().

Usage

save_spax(x, file, dir = FALSE, overwrite = FALSE, ..., datatype = "FLT8S")

Arguments

x

A spax object

file

Character; path to save the object (without extension)

dir

Logical; whether to create a directory with same name for files (default FALSE)

overwrite

Logical; whether to overwrite existing files/directory (default FALSE)

...

Additional arguments passed to terra::writeRaster()

datatype

Character; the data type of the raster file, passed to terra::writeRaster() (give it by name). The default "FLT8S" (double precision) keeps the values: read_spax() returns them as they were. "FLT4S" (single precision, terra's own default) writes files about half the size, with values rounded to about seven significant digits (a relative change of up to 6e-8).

Value

Invisibly returns the input object

Examples

# E2SFCA on the Cornwall population grid, with a Gaussian decay of 10 minutes
pop <- read_spax_example("cornwall_pop.tif")
travel <- read_spax_example("cornwall_gp_travel.tif")
result <- spax_e2sfca(pop, sf::st_drop_geometry(cornwall_gp), travel,
                      decay_params = list(method = "gaussian", sigma = 10),
                      id_col = "practice", supply_cols = "gp_fte_extg")

# Save it to temporary files: the object, and its accessibility raster
path <- tempfile("cornwall_e2sfca")
save_spax(result, path)
basename(list.files(dirname(path), pattern = basename(path)))
#> [1] "cornwall_e2sfca1d915d79961_accessibility.tif"
#> [2] "cornwall_e2sfca1d915d79961_spax.rds"         

# Read it back, then remove the files
read_spax(path)
#> <spax access> E2SFCA, 1 layer on 132 x 271 cells
#> 
#> Spatial Properties:
#> - Resolution: 0.00833333 x 0.00833333
#> - Dimensions: 132 x 271
#> 
#> Measures: 1
#> - gp_fte_extg
#> 
#> Facilities: 55
#> 
#> Parameters:
#> - Decay function: gaussian (sigma = 10)
#> - Demand normalization: identity 
unlink(paste0(path, c("_spax.rds", "_accessibility.tif")))
